description: This file defines the TransactionCoordinatorGrain class, which implements various transaction coordination methods for grains in an Orleans-based distributed system, including batch operations, exception handling, and double execution patterns.

classes.name: TransactionCoordinatorGrain
classes.description: A stateless worker grain that coordinates multiple transaction test grains, providing batch operations, exception testing, and double execution patterns.

methods.name: MultiGrainSet
methods.description: Sets a new value on multiple grains concurrently.

methods.name: MultiGrainAdd
methods.description: Adds a specified number to multiple grains concurrently.

methods.name: MultiGrainDouble
methods.description: Doubles the value of multiple grains by calling a private helper method.

methods.name: OrphanCallTransaction
methods.description: Initiates an add operation on a grain without awaiting its completion, simulating an orphaned call.

methods.name: AddAndThrow
methods.description: Adds a value to a grain and then throws an exception to test transaction abort behavior.

methods.name: MultiGrainAddAndThrow
methods.description: Performs add operations on multiple grains, with some grains throwing exceptions to test transaction rollback.

methods.name: MultiGrainSetBit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in multiple transactional bit array grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainAdd
methods.description: Adds a value to multiple grains and commits via a transaction committer.

methods.name: UpdateViolated
methods.description: Performs an add operation on a grain, potentially to test transaction violation scenarios.

methods.name: Double
methods.description: Private helper method that doubles the value of a grain.

methods.name: MultiGrainDoubleByRWRW
methods.description: Performs read-write and write-read double operations on grains in sequence.

methods.name: MultiGrainDoubleByWRWR
methods.description: Performs write-read and read-write double operations on grains in sequence.
